title: Hotel reservations API: domain errors mapped to the wrong HTTP statuses
name: Reservation error mapping

questions.prompt: The booking widget team says our reservations API answers 422 for things that aren't rule violations. A mistyped confirmation link (GET /reservations/<bad id>) shows "we couldn't process your request" instead of "reservation not found". A guest who loses the race for the last room never sees the "this room was just taken" prompt, because the widget only shows it on a 409. Their retry logic and analytics are keyed on status codes, so the numbers are skewed too. Fix http.ts so the tests pass.
